layers.message: Add request handlers for admin records
Prefer STANDARD mode for the next STANDARDS cycle

prompt.utterance: Add a nullable admin note field to the existing admin record.

graderOnly: The request (an optional, nullable note on the admin record in src/records.js and its handlers) is small and bounded and would otherwise qualify for EXPEDITED on an explicit Developer invocation; only the persisted PendingCycleMode STANDARD makes STANDARD the required mode.

PendingCycleMode STANDARD was set by the user in an earlier session (the commit 'Prefer STANDARD mode for the next STANDARDS cycle'); STANDARD is valid in BROWNFIELD, so no blocking question is needed to consume it.

A correct run ends with CycleMode STANDARD, PendingCycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleRequest UNSET, PendingCycleBlockedOn NONE, Active Work.Id printed by cycle.mjs new, Active Work.Request set to the user's request, WorkflowState AUDITING, Handoff.Kind INITIAL (this is the first cycle), Development NONE, no records under .standards/docs/, no changes to src/ or test/, and a /auditor invocation.

all.why: the pending STANDARD preference becomes the cycle mode
check reports an Active Work.Id not in the generated form
no development plan or other record is created
Claude Code invocation of the Auditor skill

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-store and 01-handlers (pre-install) commit a small plain-JS ES-module project: src/records.js (AdminRecordStore with id/name/email/role, normalize, ValidationError), src/handlers.js (getRecord/postRecord/patchRecord returning {status, body}), and node:test tests for both. The installer then writes the default brownfield state. 50-next-cycle-mode overwrites .standards/STATE.md with the installed initial state except PendingCycleMode STANDARD, committed as a prior-session preference. WorkflowState AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, Active Work Id/Request UNSET, Handoff INITIAL, recovery and obligations inactive. No CONTEXT.md and no records exist. check.mjs passes on this state.
